name: Innate Imperfections
source:
Inna is 22 and a social recluse with a most unusual skillset: assassination. Under pressure of changing her ways, she takes on an assignment very different from what's she's accustomed to. Her new job requires her to look out for a 17-year-old girl while she is in college. What sounded like an easy piece of work – with the plus of turning over a new leaf – turns out to be quite the predicament for Inna... in more than one way.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31461]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

The initial release was created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
伊娜 (Inna) 22岁，是一名社交隐士，拥有一项最不寻常的技能：暗杀。在改变生活方式的压力下，她接受了一项与她习惯的任务截然不同的任务。她的新工作要求她在一名17岁女孩上大学期间照顾她。这听起来像是一项简单的工作，而且还可以改过自新，但事实证明，这对Inna来说是一个相当大的困境……在不止一个方面。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31461]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]

初始版本是为NaNoRenO 2015创建的。
